propositions: Outbound sync resolves each create mutation's target project from the ticket's bridge_project binding against the store mapping, stamping it in the mutation's fields under _bridge_target_project, so that both Cloud and Data Center transports write to the correct project instead of their construction-time default.

The cross-project guard relaxes from single-project equality check to set membership check against the store's authoritative project set, so valid multi-project mutations to synced projects proceed while stale/typo bindings targeting unsync projects still abort pre-flight.

Tickets whose resolved project is absent from the mapping set emit no create mutation, closing the create-side gap that the pre-flight guard cannot catch because creates use local placeholders that never match the Jira key regex.
The Data Center transport drops the reserved _bridge_target_project key from the create field set before sending to Jira, preventing HTTP 400 errors from unknown field IDs.
Single-project stores with no explicit mapping fall back to the legacy behavior of using the configured project, preserving backward compatibility.
